editorial:
Imagine you are heading into a lush wildlife park for a fun trip, only to realize you are being hunted by something you cannot see. You follow Krish, a reporter who goes to Orbit Wildlife Park to find out why people are dying. At first, everyone thinks it is just a man-eating tiger on the loose. The movie sets up a great sense of dread as a group of people get stuck in the forest. It feels like a dangerous game of hide and seek where the rules keep changing, and you never know who will be the next person to go.

What really works here is the tension and the scary twists that keep you guessing. While some of the special effects feel a bit old now, the pacing is fast enough that you will stay glued to your seat. It is perfect for a weekend movie night with friends who like scary stories.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the killer is not a tiger at all, but a ghost who was murdered in the forest years ago. This spirit is responsible for all the deaths, using the tiger as a cover. In the final scenes, the survivors have to fight for their lives against this supernatural force. Most of the group dies, but the mystery is solved just as the chaos reaches its peak, leaving you with a chilling conclusion.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and surprise twists.
